Hi Elena — thanks, this is helpful. Quick note on the timezones: US daylight saving time begins on Sun, Mar 9 this year, so our clocks move forward an hour before the 11th. That means:

  - Your proposed 10:00 CET on Mar 11 will be 05:00 AM for our East Coast team (EDT).

That's pretty early for live demos. 14:00 CET would be 09:00 EDT and likely workable for us; 16:00 CET would be 11:00 EDT which is ideal.

If you want to keep 10:00 CET, we can have a smaller east-coast-only presence and record the session, but I'd recommend moving it to 14:00 or 16:00 CET so we can have the product and sales engineers in the room.

If you confirm 16:00 CET, I'll send the calendar invite (ICS) and include the Redwood pre-demo questionnaire link.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
